name: ClipToCart – Shoppable Video
author: cannyapps

sections.description:
ClipToCart – Shoppable Video brings interactive video shopping directly to your WooCommerce storefront. Easily embed videos from Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, tag products from your WooCommerce catalog, and display interactive video sliders with seamless AJAX Add to Cart functionality.

Key Features:

  • Interactive Video Player: Embed Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts effortlessly on any page or post.
  • WooCommerce Product Tagging: Tag products from your WooCommerce store with real-time price & image syncing.
  • AJAX Add to Cart: Customers can add tagged products directly to their shopping cart without leaving the video player.
  • Responsive Carousel Slider: Showcase multiple shoppable videos together in a modern mobile-first slider using shortcode [shoppable_video layout="carousel"].
  • React-Powered Admin Dashboard: Super fast, sleek React dashboard for managing video feeds and product tags.
  • Mobile First Design: Optimized for smooth touch gestures and mobile shopping.

External services

This plugin connects to external third-party services to display embedded video content on your store:

  1. TikTok Embeds:

    • Service: TikTok (ByteDance Ltd.)
    • Purpose: Renders TikTok video player embeds when a TikTok video link is added to a shoppable video widget.
    • Data sent: IP address, browser headers, and cookies required by TikTok to display the video player.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/terms-of-service/en
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/privacy-policy/en

  2. Instagram Embeds:

    • Service: Instagram (Meta Platforms, Inc.)
    • Purpose: Renders Instagram Reels video player embeds when an Instagram video link is added.
    • Data sent: IP address, browser headers, and cookies required by Meta to display the video player.
    • Terms of Service: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870
    • Privacy Policy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy

  3. YouTube Embeds:

    • Service: YouTube (Google LLC)
    • Purpose: Renders YouTube Shorts video player embeds when a YouTube video link is added.
    • Data sent: IP address and browser headers required by Google to stream embedded video content.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cliptocart-shoppable-video folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to ClipToCart in your WordPress admin sidebar to start creating shoppable video feeds.
  5. Copy the shortcode [shoppable_video layout="carousel"] or single video shortcodes [shoppable_video id="123"] and paste them onto any page, post, or widget!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, ClipToCart – Shoppable Video requires WooCommerce to be active in order to search catalog products and handle AJAX Add to Cart functionality.

Which video platforms are supported?

Currently, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts are fully supported in the free version. Support for TikTok, Facebook Reels, and direct MP4 videos will be added in upcoming releases.

How do I display all my shoppable videos in a slider?

Simply paste the shortcode [shoppable_video layout="carousel"] into any Gutenberg block, Elementor text editor, or page builder widget!
